offline.title: No internet
offline.body: Check your connection. What you typed is kept on this page.

slow.title: Slow internet
slow.body: This is taking longer than usual. Please wait a little.

expired.title: Sign in again
expired.body: For your safety you were signed out. Sign in again and carry on where you left off.

empty.title: Nothing here yet
empty.body: Add the first one to see it here.

noResult.title: Nothing matches your search
noResult.body: Try different words or remove a filter.

denied.title: You do not have permission
denied.body: Ask your school admin to give you access.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: Nothing was lost. Try again in a moment.

validation.fixFields: Fix the marked fields and try again.
